answer: Locks are recorded in wharf, expire in meadow, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 60 aliases therefore needs 108 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4247 identities would post 4817 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
